templates.guess:
The text below was given to an open-weights language model (not a Claude model). This is for an interpretability benchmark: we want to know how much of what that model is computing at this point can be guessed from the prompt text alone.

<prompt>
{prefix}
</prompt>

What is the model thinking about in this prompt? Give your single best guess of the specific thing it has in mind, in one sentence.

_source.prefix: item render (wsbench.produce.render, Qwen3.6-27B tokenizer, special tokens kept) decoded through its last read position
_source.qwen: vLLM, chat template, thinking off, user span encoded with no added/special token; n=3, T=1.0, top_p=1.0, top_k off, max_tokens 4096, per-item seed
_source.readouts: each answer at the item's last read position, layer 44 (arithmetic: every position at native layers, frozen cell judged; buggy_code: native layer)
_source.rule: per answerer: solved = some draw passes the family's scorer of record, failed = every draw decided and failing. ATI iff Qwen failed OR every frontier model (Claude slot, astra, argon) failed; invertible iff Qwen solved AND some frontier model solved; else unverified (not in the subset). Policy refusals are undecided, never retried
_source.scope: the frozen Qwen3.6-27B banks; bank_sha guards each panel entry

_not_gated.jlens_concept_pr: precision against the J-lens top-10, not a bar a lens clears
_not_gated.agentic_misalignment: a pair-scored design family: the null is the clean twin and the prompt-only floor, with no per-item answer to text-invert
_not_gated.multi_concept_directed_modulation: the prompt dictates the concepts; prompt-only is 1.0
_not_gated.directed_modulation: the instruction states the concept; items survived only because the scorer discounted instruction narration, not because the answer is hidden (Camila 2026-10-24); since plan 0028 narration counts, so the text alone answers it
_not_gated.typo: excluded from the ATI subset by design (Camila 2026-10-29)
_not_gated.typo_mt: excluded from the ATI subset by design (Camila 2026-10-30: "This should not be in ati"; plan 0033 M4)
_not_gated.multihop: excluded from the ATI subset by design (Camila 2026-10-30: "do not include the single question in ati"): one surviving item (spaceneedle-border, a gold-keying artefact re-keyed to Washington by decision Q9), not a subset
_not_gated.multihop_mt_v2: excluded from the ATI subset by design (Camila 2026-10-30); the panel names every bridge from the prompt (0/70 survived panel-v1)
_not_gated.buggy_code: pair-level headline (plan 0030); a pair verdict for the ATI gate is out of scope

moral_rationale.restamp_note: round 3: ec-v5d changes only summary-mode support (the locator); the ATI gate is native, where ec-v5d scores exactly as ec-v5c (same prompts, same draw fingerprint, quote support), so the 152-item subset stands
